cohort: The study included 444,859 women with at least one live, singleton birth in South Carolina between 2004 and 2016.
finding: The risk of incident VTE events within one and five years of delivery was significantly higher in women with HDP and those with both pre-pregnancy hypertension and HDP compared to those with neither condition, with event rates also elevated in non-Hispanic Black women.
followup_time: up to five years after delivery
